stem: How did these characteristics influence life in the colonies?

options.label: A
options.text: The New England colonies supported financial growth through high-paying industrial work.

options.label: B
options.text: The Southern colonies supported the plantation production of cash crops because of long growing seasons.

options.label: C
options.text: The Southern colonies developed large urban centers in order to support increasing manufacturing businesses.

options.label: D
options.text: The New England colonies developed large rural populations in order to support increasing agricultural production.

visual_elements: A table titled 'Characteristics of New England and Southern Colonies' with two rows comparing Economy and Climate characteristics: Economy - New England Colonies: Shipbuilding and lumber production, Southern Colonies: Agriculture; Climate - New England Colonies: Long, cold winters; moderate, short summers, Southern Colonies: Warm winters; hot, humid summers.
